title: Edict of Thessalonica makes Nicene Christianity the state religion
summary: Emperor Theodosius I, with his co-emperors, decreed that all subjects should profess the Nicene Christian faith.
reason: Theodosius wanted to end the long conflict between Nicene and Arian Christians and to unify the empire under one creed.
significance: It made Nicene Christianity the official religion of the Roman Empire.
